description: robots.txt, llms.txt and security.txt checker for up to 5 sites: fetches robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and /.well-known/security.txt in parallel. Parses robots.txt rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot and others) and the * group, says whether a given path is allowed to crawl, lists sitemap URLs, and reports security.txt contact and expiry. Use it before crawling or scraping a site. Price: 0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).
